page.layout: One page of text, single column; running head at top; page number at top left. No margin notes. Last line "mul" is a catchword-like line at the foot right.

main_text.p: ut autoritatem sibi a Deo concredi-tam, ad componendas exitiales il-las dissensiones conferat, neve præ-clarissimis suis titulis, longe Augu-stius, & ad omnem posteritatis me-moriam diuturnius nomen pacifi-catoris Ecclesiarum decesse patia-tur.

Quoniam autem frustra pacem domi quaerimus, nisi externos illos communis adversarii Pontificis Rom. conatus, & apertas in perniciem no-stram insidias depellamus: Idcirco artes illas & nefarias Antichristi coi-tiones Illustrissimo Duci optime no-tas significabit, quibus veritatis lu-cem filius tenebrarum extinguere nititur.

Monebit igitur imprimis, quot-quot per Hispaniam & Italiam in suspicionem emendatę religionis ve-niunt, eos omnes Cruci subditos Antichristi Rom. Tyrannidem & in-quisitionis atrocitatem & sævitiam experiri.

page.notes: Catchword-like word "mul" at the foot right is probably the start of "mulgari" or similar; the line is cut off at the scan edge. Some letters in the scan are blurred, notably in "pacem" and "Tyrannidem".
